headline: Management maintained steady operating margin and hiring guidance while progressively lowering constant currency revenue growth expectations across fiscal 2027.

promises.promise: Next year we see strong growth in Financial Services and Energy
promises.quote: So my sense is if you look at our current business situation, next year, we definitely see in Financial Services a strong growth, we see in Energy and Utilities, a strong growth compared to this year.
promises.evidence: Guidance covers FY27, which is still ongoing through the latest reported quarter of Sep 2026.

promises.promise: Maintain margin guidance for the future period
promises.quote: So, our view for the period in the future is we will maintain our margin guidance, and we will take all of that, that we save
promises.evidence: Operating margin guidance of 20% to 22% has been maintained and delivered through Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: Continue with headcount increases in coming quarters
promises.quote: So when you put both of those together, if in the last three quarters we have done ~13,000 net headcount increase, my sense is we will continue with the headcount increase in the coming quarters as well.
promises.evidence: Management consistently targeted around 20,000 freshers for FY27 and onboarded more than 20,000 in FY26.

promises.promise: FY27 revenue growth guidance is 1.5% to 3.5% in CC
promises.quote: Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year -on-year in constant currency terms.
promises.evidence: FY27 is ongoing; revenue growth guidance was subsequently revised to 1% to 2% in Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: FY27 operating margin guidance is 20% to 22%
promises.quote: Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
promises.evidence: Operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year, with Q2 reported margin at 21%.

promises.promise: Expect to hire around 20,000 freshers in FY27
promises.quote: This year also , we are expecting at least 20,000 freshers to be hired.
promises.evidence: Target remains approximately 20,000 freshers for the full year as of Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: FY27 effective tax rate is expected to be 29% to 30%
promises.quote: We expect effective tax rates for the FY27 to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
promises.evidence: Guidance reiterated in Q2 FY27 for the full year FY27.

shifts.change: Full year constant currency revenue growth guidance was reduced from 1.5%-3.5% in Q4 FY26 to 1.5%-3% in Q1 FY27, and further to 1%-2% in Q2 FY27.
